name: Hearthline
summary: A one-page furniture store where a room builds itself, cabinets open and rooms slide as you scroll
about: A warm, editorial furniture shop on one long page. The hero room assembles itself, vertical scroll drives a sideways tour of five rooms, a cane cabinet swings open as you scroll, and a lookbook has hotspots you can buy from. Behind it sits a full store: filtered shop, product pages with colour, size and a size diagram, a bag with promo code, and a checkout.
how: Watch the living room assemble, then scroll: the wall shifts colour, the room tour slides sideways and the Wren Cabinet doors swing open step by step.
Tap a glowing dot in the lookbook, or the plus on any card, and the piece flies into the bag in the header.
Open the shop to filter by room, material, colour, price and ready-to-ship, and sort the results; cards glide to their new places.
On a product page pick a colour (the drawing recolours) and a size (price and the dimension diagram update), then add it to the bag.
In the bag change quantities, remove pieces and try the code CHINIOT10 for 10% off; free delivery starts at PKR 50,000.
Check out with your details and a payment method; the order is confirmed with a delivery truck, confetti and an order number.
